mcqs.question: According to NIRYAT, which combination correctly describes Telangana's engineering exports during 2023–24 to 2024–25?
options: Ranked 4th in India; increased from $1,827 million to $7,536 million
Ranked 4th in India; increased from $7,536 million to $1,827 million
Ranked 38.44th in India; increased from $1,827 million to $7,536 million
Ranked 4th in India; increased from $1,827 million to $250 million
mcqs.explanation: Telangana ranked 4th in India in engineering exports, which rose from $1,827 million to $7,536 million between 2023–24 and 2024–25. The reverse sequence in the second option is incorrect; $7,536 million was the later value.

mcqs.keyword: Gobar Dhan CBG — capacity, investment and target year
mcqs.question:
Match the details of the Gobar Dhan compressed biogas project at Narmetta village with the correct combination:

List-I
(a) Number of plants
(b) Capacity of each plant
(c) Total project capacity
(d) Project investment

List-II
i. 10 TPD
ii. ₹250 crore
iii. 100 TPD
iv. 10 plants

Options:
mcqs.explanation: The Narmetta Gobar Dhan CBG project comprises 10 plants, each with a capacity of 10 TPD, giving a total capacity of 100 TPD, with an investment of ₹250 crore. Therefore, the correct pairs are a-iv, b-i, c-iii and d-ii.
